loops.name: Loop_Through_Life_Events

recordLookups.description: Gets the account record with an ID that matches the related record ID of Meeting Playbook from Get_Meeting_Records. Stores the result in the Account from Get_Account record variable.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account
recordLookups.label: Get Account

recordLookups.description: Get Account Contact Relationship to check if it's a household account. Sorted by FinServ__Primary__c descending so the primary member is rendered at the top of the Household Members section.
recordLookups.name: Get_Account_Contact_Relationship
recordLookups.label: Get All Account Contact Relationship

recordLookups.description: Gets the Contact record with an ID that matches the related record ID of Meeting Playbook.
recordLookups.name: Get_Contact
recordLookups.label: Get Contact

recordLookups.description: Gets the contact-side account records (household members or the single person account) whose IDs are in the contactAccountIds collection. Stores the results in the Get_Contact_Accounts record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Contact_Accounts
recordLookups.label: Get Contact Accounts

recordLookups.description: Gets the active financial account role records with a related account ID in the householdMemberAccountIds collection. Stores the results in the Financial Account Roles from Get_Financial_Account_Roles record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Financial_Account_Roles
recordLookups.label: Get Financial Account Roles

recordLookups.description: Gets the distinct financial account records whose IDs are in the financialAccountIds collection and whose status is Open or Active. Re-querying the accounts by ID de-duplicates joint accounts that would otherwise appear once per owning household member. Stores the results in the Get_Financial_Accounts record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Financial_Accounts
recordLookups.label: Get Financial Accounts

recordLookups.description: Gets the financial goal records with a primary owner ID in the householdMemberAccountIds collection that are not yet Completed. Stores the results in the Financial Goals from Get_Financial_Goals record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Financial_Goals
recordLookups.label: Get Financial Goals

recordLookups.description: Gets the followup summary text for the current meeting playbook's stages by matching MeetingPlaybookStageText of type FollowupSummaryPrompt against the stage IDs in the stageIdsForTasks collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Followup_Summary_Text
recordLookups.label: Get Followup Summary Text

recordLookups.description: Gets the lead record with an ID that matches the related record ID of Meeting Playbook.
recordLookups.name: Get_Lead
recordLookups.label: Get Lead

recordLookups.description: Gets the meeting playbook stage records with a meeting playbook ID that matches the ID of the current meeting playbook in the loop. Stores the results in the Meeting Playbook Stages from Get_Meeting_Playbook_Stages record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Meeting_Playbook_Stages_Ids
recordLookups.label: Get Meeting Playbook Stages Ids

recordLookups.description: Gets up to 15 case records with an account ID in the householdMemberAccountIds collection and any status except Closed. Records are sorted by LastModifiedDate in descending order (most recently updated first). Stores the results in the Cases from Get_Open_Cases record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Open_Cases
recordLookups.label: Get Open Cases

recordLookups.description: Gets up to 15 open opportunity records with an account ID in the householdMemberAccountIds collection and modified within the last year. Records are sorted by LastModifiedDate in descending order (most recently updated first). Stores the results in the Get_Opportunities record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Opportunities
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunities

recordLookups.description: Gets up to 3 meeting playbook records with a related record ID that matches the ID of the account from Get_Account. Records are sorted by CreatedDate in descending order (most recent first). Stores the results in the Meeting Playbooks from Get_Past_Meetings record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Past_Meetings
recordLookups.label: Get Past Meeting Playbooks

recordLookups.description: Gets the task records with an ID that matches any ID in the stageIdsForTasks collection. Stores the results in the Tasks from Get_Tasks_for_Stages record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Tasks_for_Stages
recordLookups.label: Get Tasks

recordLookups.description: Gets up to 15 person life event records with a primary person ID in the personContactIds collection and an event date that is the current date or one in the future. Records are sorted by EventDate in ascending order. Stores the results in the Person Life Events from Get_Upcoming_Life_Events record collection.
recordLookups.name: Get_Upcoming_Life_Events
recordLookups.label: Get Person Life Events
